done.detail: Implemented KernelProbe for version and security config extraction. Added keyword-based filtering for KASLR/SMEP/SMAP and graceful degradation for non-root users. Verified with tests/verify_kernel.py.

Implemented DaemonProbe with hybrid psutil/systemctl approach. Resolves listening ports to binaries via systemd inventory fallback when PIDs are restricted. Fixed binary path parsing bugs. Verified with tests/verify_daemons.py.
Implemented Version -> CPE -> CVE flow. Integrated Shodan/Metasploit APIs for CPE resolution, added TTL caching, and robust HTTP error handling. Verified via E2E tests.
